glosses.notes: Used when something is plainly the case, often with a sense that others should already be able to see it.

examples.sentence: 孩子明明昨天晚上答应得很好，但是今天一进教室就把要交的材料全忘在家里了。
这件事明明前天已经说清楚了，但是一到开会的时候，还是有人把最重要的顺序记反。
外面明明一直在下大雨，但是他还是觉得自己跑过去会更快，结果回来的时候连报告都湿了。

example_translations.translation: The child had clearly promised last night, but the moment he walked into the classroom today, he realized he had left all the materials he needed to hand in at home.
This matter had obviously already been explained clearly the day before yesterday, but as soon as the meeting started, someone still reversed the most important order.
It was obviously pouring outside, but he still felt that running over there himself would be faster, and by the time he came back even the report was wet.

glosses.notes: Refers to how well known someone or something is, especially in a positive public sense.

examples.sentence: 这家店的名气虽然越来越大，但是老板还是坚持每天自己先到，因为他怕后面忙起来以后味道会变。
他年轻的时候没什么名气，但是后来让大家一直记得他的，不是他有多出名，而是做事一直很认真。
父亲说，地方小不代表没有名气，有些人走很远过来，就是为了看一眼那条老街现在的样子。

example_translations.translation: Although this shop has grown more and more famous, the owner still insists on arriving first every day, because he worries the taste will change once things get busy later.
When he was young he had no real fame, but what kept people remembering him later was not how famous he became, but how seriously he always worked.
Father says that a place being small does not mean it has no reputation; some people come from very far away just to take one look at how that old street looks now.

glosses.notes: A well-known place that people visit for its scenery, history, or cultural interest.

examples.sentence: 第一次来这个城市的人，往往先去最有名的名胜，但是父亲反而更想带孩子看看那些真正还有人住的老地方。
老师讲到那处名胜的时候，没有急着让我们背名字，而是先问如果真的走到那里，最先会看见什么。
这本书把几个名胜写得很热闹，但是母亲看完以后还是觉得，真正打动人的，是路上看到的那些人。

example_translations.translation: People who come to this city for the first time often go first to the most famous scenic sites, but Father would rather take the child to see those old places where people still really live.
When the teacher talked about that famous scenic spot, she did not rush to make us memorize the name, but first asked what we would see first if we truly walked there.
This book describes several famous scenic spots very vividly, but after reading it Mother still felt that what truly moved people were the people seen along the road.

glosses.notes: Can be a verb for giving a command, or a noun meaning the command itself.

examples.sentence: 负责人没有马上命令大家停下来，而是先把情况说明白，再让每个人自己看后面该怎么做。
父亲年轻时最怕听见那种不问原因就下来的命令，因为一到真正出问题的时候，谁都不知道该先改哪里。
医生只说了一句很简单的命令：这几天先别碰水，别觉得现在不太疼了，就可以和以前一样乱来。

example_translations.translation: The person in charge did not immediately order everyone to stop. Instead, he first explained the situation clearly and then let each person decide what needed to be done next.
When Father was young, he most feared hearing that kind of order that came down without asking the reason, because when real problems appeared, no one knew what should be changed first.
The doctor gave only one very simple command: for the next few days, do not touch water. Do not think that just because it does not hurt much now, you can fool around the way you used to.

glosses.notes: To give something an official or chosen name.

examples.sentence: 学校后来给那间新教室命名的时候，没有直接用大人的名字，而是让孩子们先说自己最想留下什么。
这条小路为什么会这样命名，父亲小时候也问过很多次，后来才知道原来和前面那条河有关系。
经理说，给一个项目命名看上去很小，但是如果一开始就叫得太满，后面真做起来反而容易让人失望。

example_translations.translation: When the school later named that new classroom, it did not directly use an adult’s name, but first let the children say what they most wanted to leave there.
Why this little road was named this way was something Father also asked many times in childhood; only later did he learn that it was related to the river in front.
The manager said that naming a project looks like a small matter, but if you name it too grandly from the start, people are more likely to be disappointed once the real work begins.

glosses.notes: To copy the actions, way of speaking, or style of someone or something.

examples.sentence: 孩子刚开始学的时候，总爱模仿老师每一个动作，但是后来老师反而提醒他，先把自己的问题看清楚更重要。
他讲话的样子太特别了，所以班里的孩子一回去就爱模仿，但是真正让人佩服的还是他看问题的方法。
医生说，恢复练习不能只模仿别人做得多快，还得先看自己的身体现在到底能不能跟上。

example_translations.translation: When the child first started learning, he always liked imitating every movement the teacher made, but later the teacher instead reminded him that it mattered more to see his own problem clearly first.
The way he spoke was so distinctive that the children in class liked to imitate him as soon as they got back, but what truly made people admire him was still the way he looked at problems.
The doctor said that recovery exercises cannot be only about imitating how fast someone else does them; you also have to first look at whether your own body can keep up right now.

glosses.notes: To recreate a situation, process, or condition so it can be studied or practiced.

examples.sentence: 为了不让大家一到真正考试的时候就乱，老师先把最难的部分拿出来模拟了一次，结果很多小问题马上都看出来了。
医院后来用系统模拟了好几种情况，才决定如果晚上突然停电，谁先去楼上，谁留在下面看机器。
父亲看那个节目最有意思的地方，不是结果，而是他们怎么用很简单的材料把过去的场面模拟出来。

example_translations.translation: So that everyone would not panic once the real exam began, the teacher first pulled out the hardest part and simulated it once, and as a result many small problems immediately became visible.

The hospital later simulated several different situations with the system before deciding that if the power suddenly went out at night, who should go upstairs first and who should stay below to watch the machines.
What Father found most interesting about that program was not the result, but how they used very simple materials to simulate scenes from the past.

glosses.notes: A person whose appearance, clothing, or movements are shown for photography, fashion, or display.

examples.sentence: 她第一次给那家小店当模特儿的时候，其实紧张得连手往哪里放都不知道，后来还是老板先让她慢慢走一遍。
孩子原来以为模特儿只是站在那里让别人看，但是看完那场表演以后，才发现每个动作都得反复练很多次。
这本杂志请来的模特儿名气很大，但是母亲真正注意到的，不是衣服有多贵，而是照片里的颜色特别自然。

example_translations.translation: The first time she worked as a model for that small shop, she was so nervous she did not even know where to put her hands, and in the end the owner first asked her to walk through it slowly once.
The child had originally thought a model just stood there for others to look at, but after watching that performance, he discovered that every movement had to be practiced over and over.
The model invited by this magazine is very famous, but what Mother truly noticed was not how expensive the clothes were, but how natural the colors in the photos looked.

glosses.notes: A two-wheeled motor vehicle that is ridden rather than driven like a car.

examples.sentence: 父亲年轻时每天骑摩托车来回上班，所以后来一听见那种声音，还是会马上想起那条很长的旧路。
那位工作人员把摩托车停好以后，先低头检查了半天，怕一会儿上山的时候又像上次那样突然出问题。
孩子一看见外面有一辆红色摩托车从门口过去，就一直追着问那个人要去哪里，连饭都差一点忘了吃。

example_translations.translation: When Father was young, he rode a motorcycle to and from work every day, so later on, whenever he heard that kind of sound, he would immediately think of that long old road.
After parking the motorcycle, that staff member lowered his head and checked it for a long time, afraid that on the way up the mountain it might suddenly have a problem again like last time.
As soon as the child saw a red motorcycle pass by the entrance outside, he kept asking where that person was going and almost even forgot to eat.

glosses.notes: A physical or structural model used to show shape, layout, or design.

examples.sentence: 老师把那个城市模型放到桌子中间以后，很多原来看不清的方向一下就明白了，连最难的部分也好讲多了。
孩子做飞机模型的时候，前面一直都很认真，但是到最后装那两个小零件的时候，手还是一下停住了。
医院后来根据这个模型重新安排了人怎么走，所以以前总堵在门口的情况，现在已经少了很多。

example_translations.translation: After the teacher put that city model in the middle of the table, many directions that had been hard to see suddenly became clear, and even the most difficult part became much easier to explain.
While making the airplane model, the child had been very serious the whole time, but when it came to fitting the last two small parts, his hand suddenly stopped.
The hospital later rearranged how people should move around based on this model, so the situation that used to block up the entrance has now been reduced a lot.

glosses.notes: Describes doing something without speaking or drawing attention to oneself.

examples.sentence: 父亲没有马上说什么，只是把手里的东西一点一点收好，然后默默坐回原来的地方，像是在想很久以前的事。
她平时总是默默把大家不愿意先做的小事做完，所以真到最忙的时候，很多人第一个想到的还是她。
孩子站在门口听完以后没有哭，只是默默点了点头，然后回去把那张旧照片重新放进书里。

example_translations.translation: Father did not say anything right away. He simply put the things in his hands away bit by bit, then sat back in his old place silently, as if thinking about something from long ago.
She usually silently finishes the small tasks that everyone else is unwilling to do first, so when things become busiest, she is still the first person many people think of.
After listening at the doorway, the child did not cry. He only nodded silently, then went back and put that old photo back into the book.

glosses.notes: The visible look or manner something or someone gives off.

examples.sentence: 那孩子平时看着安安静静，但是一说到自己最喜欢的比赛，眼睛立刻就亮起来，连说话的模样都和刚才不一样了。

examples.meaning_en: the way someone looks while doing something
examples.sentence: 母亲看见父亲低头找东西的模样，就知道他其实已经想起来那把钥匙放在哪儿了，只是不愿意先承认。
这家店外面看着很普通，但是里面整理好的模样让第一次来的人一下就觉得安心，连说话都轻了很多。

example_translations.translation: The child usually looks very quiet, but the moment he starts talking about his favorite competition, his eyes light up at once, and even the way he speaks is no longer like it was a moment ago.
As soon as Mother saw the way Father was lowering his head looking for things, she knew he had actually already remembered where he had put that key; he just did not want to admit it first.
From the outside this shop looks very ordinary, but the tidy look inside makes first-time visitors feel at ease immediately, and even their voices become softer.

glosses.notes: This row teaches 母 in the sense of female, especially when distinguishing animals by sex.

examples.sentence: 孩子原来还分不清哪只是母，哪只是公，但是听老人慢慢讲过以后，再看声音和动作就大概知道了。
老板先问要公还是母，因为很多人买回去的做法不同，所以真正想要的味道也不一样。
医生一看就说，这只猫应该是母，因为它一直安静地待在里面，外面叫得更响的那只才像公。

example_translations.translation: The child still could not tell which one was female and which one was male at first, but after listening to the old man explain it slowly, he could roughly tell from the sound and movements.
The owner first asked whether you wanted the male or the female one, because many people cook them differently after buying them back, so the flavor they truly want is also different.
With one look the doctor said that this cat should be female, because it stayed quietly inside the whole time, while the one outside crying more loudly seemed more like the male.

glosses.notes: The first language a person grows up speaking.

examples.sentence: 老师说，孩子先把母语学好，不会让后面学别的语言更慢，反而能更快知道很多话为什么这样说。
她虽然离开家乡很多年了，但是一听见别人用母语叫她小时候的名字，眼睛还是会一下红起来。
父亲看那本介绍各地文化的书时才发现，很多人就算会说几种语言，真正做梦时还是会先回到母语里。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that if a child first learns the mother tongue well, it will not make learning other languages slower later; instead, it will make it easier to understand why many things are said the way they are.
Although she has been away from her hometown for many years, the moment she hears someone call her by her childhood name in her mother tongue, her eyes still turn red at once.

While reading that book introducing cultures from different places, Father realized that even if many people can speak several languages, when they dream they still first return to their mother tongue.

glosses.notes: Wood material used for building, making things, or structural work.

examples.sentence: 这座老房子用的木材和现在常见的不太一样，所以哪怕已经过了这么多年，门一推开还是有那种很特别的味道。
父亲买木材的时候最怕只看表面，因为有些东西刚拿到手里很像，但是真正开始做以后问题才慢慢出来。
工作人员把那批木材先放在房子里最干的地方，不然一到下雨的时候，后面很多安排都会跟着变。

example_translations.translation: The timber used in this old house is not quite the same as what is commonly seen now, so even after so many years, as soon as the door is pushed open there is still a very distinctive smell.

When Father buys timber, what he fears most is judging only by the surface, because some pieces look very similar when first held in the hand, but the problems only slowly appear once you truly start working with them.
The staff first put that batch of timber in the driest part of the house, otherwise once it rained later, many of the arrangements that followed would change with it.

glosses.notes: A list that shows what is included and where each part can be found.

examples.sentence: 孩子看那本书的时候先翻了目录，结果发现自己最想知道的问题其实在最后一部分，所以马上又坐下来接着看。
老师说，写报告以前先把目录想清楚，不只是为了好看，而是怕写到一半才发现前后顺序根本对不上。
这份资料原来没有目录，所以每次有人来问同一个问题，工作人员都得从头翻到后面才能找到。

example_translations.translation: When the child read that book, he first flipped to the table of contents and discovered that the question he most wanted answered was actually in the last section, so he immediately sat back down and kept reading.

The teacher said that before writing a report, you should first think the table of contents through clearly. It is not just for looking good, but because otherwise you may only halfway through discover that the order from front to back does not match at all.
This set of materials originally had no contents list, so every time someone came asking the same question, the staff had to flip from the beginning to the back before they could find it.

glosses.notes: Powdered milk, often bought for babies, children, or special dietary use.

examples.sentence: 孩子生病以后什么都不太想吃，所以医生先让家里准备一点奶粉，怕晚上真饿的时候一点东西都喝不下去。
母亲买奶粉的时候不会只看外面写得多好，而是先把后面的说明认真看完，再决定到底带哪一种回家。
那家店一开门就有人来问奶粉到了没有，因为前几天消息一出来，很多家长心里一直都不太安。

example_translations.translation: After the child got sick, he did not really want to eat anything, so the doctor first told the family to prepare some milk powder, afraid that if he became hungry at night, he would not be able to drink anything at all.
When Mother buys milk powder, she does not look only at how well the outside is written. Instead, she first carefully reads all the instructions on the back before deciding which kind to take home.
As soon as that shop opened, people came asking whether the milk powder had arrived yet, because once the news came out a few days earlier, many parents had been uneasy.

glosses.notes: The part of a topic or task that is hardest to understand or handle well.

examples.sentence: 老师把这课最容易错的地方先放到前面讲，因为真正的难点不是最后那一步，而是很多人前面想得太快。
父亲看完那份说明以后才发现，自己原来一直以为最麻烦的是时间，其实真正的难点在怎么和别人配合。
医生说，这次恢复里最大的难点不是多走几步，而是要每天都按时做同样的动作，不能今天做明天停。

example_translations.translation: The teacher put the places in this lesson that are easiest to get wrong at the front first, because the real difficult point is not the final step, but that many people think too quickly earlier on.
Only after reading that explanation did Father realize that what he had always thought most troublesome was time, while the true difficult point was actually how to coordinate with other people.
The doctor said that the biggest difficult point in this recovery was not walking a few more steps, but doing the same movements on time every day and not doing them today only to stop tomorrow.

glosses.notes: The continent around the South Pole.

examples.sentence: 孩子第一次在纪录片里看见南极洲的时候，最先记住的不是雪有多白，而是那里安静得连人的声音都很少。
老师指着地图说，南极洲虽然离我们很远，但是那里天气一变，后面很多研究的人都会马上开始重新看数据。
父亲年轻时总觉得南极洲只是书里的名字，后来真正看了很多照片以后，才知道那里和自己想的完全不一样。

example_translations.translation: The first time the child saw Antarctica in a documentary, what he remembered first was not how white the snow was, but that it was so quiet there that even human voices were rare.
Pointing at the map, the teacher said that although Antarctica is far from us, once the weather changes there, many people doing research later begin rechecking the data at once.
When Father was young, he always felt that Antarctica was only a name from books, but after later seeing many real photographs, he realized that it was completely different from what he had imagined.

glosses.notes: The continent south of North America.

examples.sentence: 老师讲到南美洲的时候，没有急着让我们记国家的名字，而是先问大家那边的天气和植物为什么会那么不同。
孩子第一次在地图上找到南美洲以后，一直觉得那个地方离家太远，远得像只会出现在故事里一样。
这本书写到南美洲很多城市的时候，不只是介绍风景，还一直在讲那边的人怎么把日子过得又忙又热闹。

example_translations.translation: When the teacher talked about South America, she did not rush to make us memorize the names of countries, but first asked why the weather and plants there could be so different.
The first time the child found South America on the map, he kept feeling that the place was too far from home, so far that it seemed as if it could appear only in stories.
When this book writes about many cities in South America, it does not only introduce the scenery, but keeps talking about how the people there live busy and lively lives.

glosses.notes: Used when something cannot really be avoided, especially once conditions are already in place.

examples.sentence: 第一次带这么多人一起做项目，前面安排得再认真，后面一忙起来还是难免会有几个地方顾不过来。
父亲说，人年纪一大，很多以前不在意的小问题难免会慢慢出来，所以平时能早点休息就别总等到太晚。
孩子刚换到新学校的时候，心里难免会有点不安，但是只要有人肯先和他说几句话，后面就没有那么难了。

example_translations.translation: The first time you lead so many people on a project together, no matter how carefully the earlier arrangements are made, once things get busy later it is still hard to avoid having a few places you cannot fully take care of.
Father says that once people get older, many small problems they used not to care about will inevitably appear little by little, so if you can go to rest earlier, do not always wait until too late.
When the child had just changed to a new school, some uneasiness was hard to avoid, but as long as someone was willing to say a few words to him first, things later were not so hard.

glosses.notes: An everyday word for the head, often used in ordinary speech rather than formal medical language.

examples.sentence: 他一着急就用手摸自己的脑袋，所以母亲一看那个动作就知道，这件事他其实还没有真正想清楚。
孩子从床上跳下来时一不小心碰到了脑袋，吓得父亲马上把手里的东西都放下，先过去看他有没有事。
医生笑着说，你别总把这些事都装在脑袋里，能写下来的先写下来，不然晚上越想越睡不着。

example_translations.translation: Whenever he gets anxious, he touches his head with his hand, so as soon as Mother sees that movement, she knows that he still has not truly thought this matter through.

When the child jumped down from the bed, he accidentally bumped his head, and Father was so startled that he immediately set down everything in his hands and went over first to see whether the child was all right.

The doctor said with a smile, do not keep putting all these things only in your head. If they can be written down, write them down first, otherwise the more you think at night, the less you can sleep.

glosses.notes: Often refers to thinking ability, mental clarity, or what is going on in someone’s head.

examples.sentence: 他那天忙了一整天，晚上开会时脑子已经不太清楚了，所以负责人只让大家先说最重要的三件事。
父亲常说，读书不是把话全放进脑子里就行，更重要的是过几天以后，你还能不能知道它到底为什么对。
孩子一发烧，母亲最怕的不是他不想吃饭，而是整个人看着没精神，连脑子都像转得比平时慢。

example_translations.translation: He had been busy the whole day, and by the evening meeting his mind was no longer very clear, so the person in charge asked everyone to talk only about the three most important things first.
Father often says that reading is not just about putting every line into your head. What matters more is whether after a few days you can still know why it is right.
When the child got a fever, what Mother feared most was not that he did not want to eat, but that he looked drained all over, as if even his mind was turning more slowly than usual.

glosses.notes: The deeper meaning or substance inside words, ideas, or artistic work, not just the surface form.

examples.sentence: 老师说，这句话表面上看很简单，但是真正的内涵并不只在那几个字上，而是要连前后的情况一起看。
这篇文章如果只看故事本身，不一定觉得多特别，但是后面慢慢想一想，就会发现里面的内涵其实很深。
父亲觉得那幅画最打动人的，不是颜色有多亮，而是安静看久以后，里面那种说不清的内涵会慢慢出来。

example_translations.translation: The teacher said that on the surface this sentence looks simple, but its real connotation does not lie only in those few words; you have to view it together with what comes before and after.
If you look only at the story itself, this article may not seem especially remarkable, but if you think about it slowly afterward, you discover that its inner meaning is actually quite deep.
Father felt that what most moved him in that painting was not how bright the colors were, but that after looking quietly for a long time, the hard-to-explain inner meaning inside it slowly emerged.

glosses.notes: The hospital department that treats internal illnesses and medical conditions rather than surgery.

examples.sentence: 孩子一开始以为只是小问题，但是医生看完检查以后还是让他先去内科，因为前面那些不舒服已经不是一天两天了。
医院后来把内科和外科的方向写得更清楚，所以第一次来的人也不用像以前那样站在门口反复看。
父亲陪老人去看内科的时候才发现，很多人最难的不是排多久队，而是前面那些话不知道该怎么跟医生说。

example_translations.translation: The child at first thought it was only a small problem, but after looking over the examination, the doctor still told him to go first to internal medicine, because those discomforts had not been there for only a day or two.

The hospital later marked the directions to internal medicine and surgery much more clearly, so even people coming for the first time no longer had to stand at the entrance studying them again and again as before.

Only when Father accompanied the old man to internal medicine did he realize that what is hardest for many people is not how long they have to wait in line, but not knowing how to explain those earlier symptoms to the doctor.
